default_server_listings.configuration.co: This configuration file contains the default server listings that will be added to the server list when the game is first launched.
If this is disabled, the default server listings will not be added to the server list when the game is first launched.

This is a list of default server listings that will be added to the server list when the game is first launched. Each entry must contain a name, address, and resource pack status. The resource pack status can be one of the following: ENABLED, DISABLED, or PROMPT.
